info.title: Tavily Search and Extract API
info.description: Our REST API provides seamless access to Tavily Search, a powerful search engine for LLM agents, and Tavily Extract, an advanced web scraping solution optimized for LLMs.

post.summary: Retrieve raw web content from specified URLs
post.description: Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results. Check both arrays even when the response is HTTP 200. Request options apply to every URL in the batch.

requestBody.description: Parameters for the Tavily Extract request.

oneOf.description: The URL to extract content from.
A list of 1–20 URLs to extract in one request.

query.description: User intent for reranking extracted content chunks. When provided, chunks are reranked based on relevance to this query.

chunks_per_source.description: Chunks are short content snippets (about 800 characters each) pulled directly from the source. Use `chunks_per_source` to define the maximum number of relevant chunks returned per source and to control the `raw_content` length. Chunks will appear in the `raw_content` field as: `<chunk 1> [...] <chunk 2> [...] <chunk 3>`. If a page splits into no more chunks than `chunks_per_source`, its full content is returned. Available only when `query` is provided. Must be between 1 and 5.

extract_depth.description: The depth of the extraction process. `advanced` extraction retrieves more data, including tables and embedded content, with higher success but may increase latency.`basic` extraction costs 1 credit per 5 successful URL extractions, while `advanced` extraction costs 2 credits per 5 successful URL extractions.

include_images.description: Include a list of images extracted from the URLs in the response. Default is false.

include_favicon.description: Whether to include the favicon URL for each result.

format.description: The format of the extracted web page content. `markdown` returns content in markdown format. `text` returns plain text and may increase latency.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the URL extraction before timing out. Must be between 1.0 and 60.0 seconds. If not specified, default timeouts are applied based on extract_depth: 10 seconds for basic extraction and 30 seconds for advanced extraction.

include_usage.description: Whether to include credit usage information in the response. `NOTE:`The value may be 0 if the total successful URL extractions has not yet reached 5 calls. See our [Credits & Pricing documentation](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits) for details.

200.description: Extraction completed. Check results and failed_results for each URL. HTTP 200 can have an empty results array when all valid URLs fail during extraction; output order is not guaranteed.

results.description: A list of extracted content from the provided URLs.

url.description: The URL from which the content was extracted.

raw_content.description: The full content extracted from the page. When `query` is provided, contains the top-ranked chunks joined by `[...]` separator.

images.description: This is only available if `include_images` is set to `true`. A list of image URLs extracted from the page.

favicon.description: The favicon URL for the result.

failed_results.description: A list of URLs that could not be processed.

url.description: The URL that failed to be processed.

error.description: An error message describing why the URL couldn't be processed.

response_time.description: Time in seconds it took to complete the request.

usage.description: Credit usage details for the request.

request_id.description: A unique request identifier you can share with customer support to help resolve issues with specific requests.

400.description: Bad Request. More than 20 URLs, an empty URL list, or no URLs passing validation are rejected. When all URLs fail validation, detail.failed_results describes the individual failures.

failed_results.description: A list of URLs that could not be processed.

url.description: The URL that failed to be processed.

error.description: An error message describing why the URL couldn't be processed.

401.description: Unauthorized - Your API key is wrong or missing.

429.description: Too Many Requests. Error messages and retry delays can vary by rate-limit rule.

432.description: Key limit or Plan Limit exceeded

500.description: Internal Server Error - We had a problem with our server.

RetryAfter.description: When present, the number of seconds to wait before retrying. Read the returned value; the delay can vary.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer authentication header in the form Bearer <token>, where <token> is your Tavily API key (e.g., Bearer tvly-YOUR_API_KEY).
